description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests for retrieving different types of troubleshooting logs (system, event, firewall) within a specified time range. It processes input parameters, reads log entries from system commands' output, filters logs based on time, and outputs the results in JSON format, also saving logs to temporary files.

methods.name: str2time
methods.description: Converts a date string to a structured array with formatted_time, firewall_time, and a timestamp (timeU). It parses logs with or without year information and handles date rollover into the previous year if necessary.
